column1: PARLIAMENT  OF  THE  DEMOCRATIC
SOCIALIST  REPUBLIC  OF
SRI  LANKA
SECURED  TRANSACTIONS
A
BILL
to provide for an institutional framework for the regulation of Secured
Transactions  in  movable  property  by  the  establishment  of  the  Secured
Transactions  Registration  Authority;  to  set  out  the  powers  and  duties
of such Authority; to provide for the determining of priorities amongst
creditors  having  competing  security  rights  in  the  movable  property  of
their debtors; to set out the rights and duties of parties to security agreements;
to  provide  for  the  establishment  and  maintenance  of  a  registry  of
security  rights  in  movable  property  and for  matters  connected  therewith
or incidental thereto
Presented by the Minister of Finance on 23rd of October, 2019
(Published in the Gazette on August 16, 2019)
Ordered by Parliament to be printed
[Bill No. 307]
